newsitem.title: UK: LEP France appoints chief executive officer.
newsitem.headline: LEP France appoints chief executive officer.

text.p: LEP International (France) SA, part of the LEP Group Plc, said it has appointed Mike Berry as chief executive officer.
Berry, who has already taken up his new position, joined LEP in 1979. In LEP International, UK, he has most recently been director of southern operations.
In his new appointment Berry reports directly to Andrew Bernard, LEP's European regional director.

In additions to its Garonor headquarters, LEP France has office and freight handling facilities at Dijon, Le Harve, Lyons, Perpiguan and Marseilles, and at Orly, Roissy, Lesquin (Lille), Dijon, Lyons and Merignac (Bordeaux) airports. - Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44 171 542 7706 Fax:5017
